improve handling of deleted branches.

In the scenario where a branch is created, but is then deleted and
re-branched, we need to be smarter.

The way we handle this now is that we treat each generation of a branch
as a distinct branch entity during analysis.

During completion, any dead branches are created in a fixup area so that
they will not appear under that branch name in the final repo.
The fixup area is deleted at the end of the run.

Deleted tags are no longer represented in the git repo.

be smarter about processing the origin of copies.

Trying also to eliminate weird behavior in the case where a branch
is deleted and re-created; the end result at the moment is that
the branch does not appear in the final git repo, and fast-import

modernize NSImage usage

- Fixes up NSImage to use a technique that doesn't depend on the
  DPI of the current screen and just uses pixels
- Fixes a crash when releasing the image; the crash was caused by
  a `memset` call getting a different size for the filename buffer.
  I solved this by passing the size down, which is safer than just
  assuming anyway.  I added an ASAN cmake option to make it easier
  to turn up the debugging and understand where the memory corruption
  had come from.
